hash_normalization: UTF-8 bytes with CRLF converted to LF (a leading BOM is kept); selector spans its leading comment and attribute lines through the closing brace and final newline

reviews.review_scope: Rust half of the PcaiAsyncResult ABI contract: asserts size 24 and offset_of! 0/8/16/20 for status, text, tokens_generated, prompt_tokens_estimated. Binds the Rust layout only; the managed half is the PcaiNative.Tests selectors below. The 22 other mirrored structs have no Rust-side test.
platform_prerequisites: 64-bit target (cfg(target_pointer_width = "64")); the test does not exist on 32-bit builds
Rust 1.77 or later for core::mem::offset_of! (workspace rust-version is 1.95)
cargo test -p pcai-inference --no-default-features --features server,ffi --lib -- ffi (no native library, GPU or model needed)
reviews.rationale: Pins the exact layout the C# mirror must reproduce; a Rust field change breaks this test and points at InferenceModule.PcaiAsyncResult.

reviews.review_scope: Hand-derived expected size and field offsets for 23 managed structs (one row per struct, Rust source named in a comment). The numbers are transcribed from the Rust definitions, so the table cannot detect Rust-only drift except for PcaiAsyncResult, which the Rust selector above binds.
platform_prerequisites: 64-bit process; the numbers are the x64 ABI that PcaiNative ships for
Windows x64 target of the product; the test itself only uses Marshal.SizeOf and Marshal.OffsetOf and loads no native library
.NET 8 (net8.0), test project built with PlatformTarget x64
reviews.rationale: Every field of every row is pinned, including padding fields, so an added or removed managed field changes the table or fails the field-set check.

reviews.review_scope: Parameterized managed ABI suite over the MirroredStructs table: Marshal.SizeOf, declared-field-set equality and Marshal.OffsetOf per field. Fails, not skips, when the process is not 64-bit. Positive control: removing PcaiAsyncResult.TokensGenerated and PromptTokensEstimated fails it with Expected 24, Actual 16.
platform_prerequisites: 64-bit process (asserted); the test project sets PlatformTarget x64
reviews.rationale: Detects managed-side size, order or type drift in any mirrored struct, which would let the native side write past a caller-allocated return buffer.
